_what_this_is: Acceptance row 12 (recovery preservation), measured. A real Volume Shadow Copy created on D:, a real file encrypted in place, restored from the snapshot, hash round-trip verified, and the snapshot deleted afterwards. Carried as 'partial - VSS-backed restore not measured' since Phase 6 because reaching it needs an elevated shell.
_the_bug_this_found: The first attempt failed with 'not present in the snapshot' for a file that was in the snapshot. restore_file joined a forward-slash relative path onto a GLOBALROOT device object, and the Windows verbatim prefix disables separator normalisation - so forward slashes stop being separators. Every restore from a genuine shadow copy had been broken. No test caught it because every test used the dev fallback root, an ordinary directory where both separators resolve. Fixed by join_under_snapshot; regression lives in services/response/recovery/tests/test_snapshot_paths.py.
